name: smwgraphics-terraria-forest-biome
title: Terraria - Forest Biome
description:
A foreground tileset used in the forest biome in Terraria. Credit isn't required if you use this, but it would be appreciated.

Note: Only the decoration tiles needed custom Map16 tiles. The ground tiles use SMW's original Map16 tiles.

Note: Two palette files are included. One will make the tileset look like that it's from the forest biome, while the other one will make it look like it's from the corruption biome.
